verdicts.reason: The two layouts are practically the same: the row of pens sits above a centred 'STATIONERY SALE' headline. In both, the lone pencil that ended the original banner floats off to the right below the text and lines up with nothing, and the bottom ~40% of the canvas is empty red, so the composition is top-heavy and looks unfinished. B sits only a few pixels higher than A, which changes nothing, and neither one rebuilds the original pen-row-into-headline rhythm with any intent.
